Tree source: en_in.sitemap.xml -> 31 en_in.pages.subdepartment.N.xml files (2969 URLs unioned) filtered for 'bath', cross-checked against the live mega-menu (Home > Shop by Room > Bathroom) and each category page's own tab strip -- both agree on the same 7-node Bathroom-room tree (Bathroom/Soap Dispensers/Towels/Shower Curtains/Bathroom Storage/Accessories/Laundry Bags), so no under-reported nodes. Qty verified from the rendered '<N> Products' header on each leaf page (JS-hydrated storefront, tier-1 HTML was empty pre-hydration). Laundry Bags and Laundry & Cleaning Products (brooms/sprays) -> out of Bathroom scope per rule 3 (general laundry/cleaning, not a bathroom fixture/accessory/hardware type), excluded, not sent to review (not ambiguous). Parent https://www2.hm.com/en_in/home/shop-by-room/bathroom.html (265 products, aggregate of all 7 tabs incl. seasonal Christmas towels) excluded per rule 24 -- valid subcategories exist. Duplicate-taxonomy finding: https://www2.hm.com/en_in/home/shop-by-product/bath-shower/bathroom-accessories.html (30 products) was compared product-ID-by-product-ID (via page JS, article a[href*=productpage]) against https://www2.hm.com/en_in/home/shop-by-room/bathroom/accessories.html (31 products) -- 30 of 31 product IDs are identical, confirming these are the same underlying catalog node exposed via two different nav taxonomies (Shop by Room vs Shop by Product) with a live 1-item stock/timing drift, not two genuine categories. Recorded once under the Shop-by-Room path (the canonical Bathroom-room hub used for rule 23 navbar extraction); the alternate URL logged to review as a duplicate, not double-counted. Cross-category dedup: all 4 candidate leaf URLs checked against pipeline/bathroom_json_archive/cross_category_url_index.json -- no hits in Furniture/Storage/Wall_Decor/Textile. No bathroom mirror, vanity, fixture, tap, or ceramic-sanitaryware category exists on this storefront (H&M Home India sells only soft-goods-adjacent bathroom accessories, soap dispensers and small storage/shelving -- confirmed absent via full sitemap+menu tree, not a search-only null result).
